caseName: Nevada Consolidated Copper Corp. v. Railroad Retirement Board
caseNameFull: Nevada Consolidated Copper Corp. v. Railroad Retirement Board
attorneys: Messrs. C. C. Parsons, H. Thomas Austern, and Elmer L. Brock for petitioners. Solicitor General Fahy for respondents.
